question: From what single source do all the previously mentioned sacred texts arise?
premises: All the aforementioned texts are gathered as one totality.
The own āgama is named as their source.
The Goddess is addressed as the supreme recipient of this teaching.
inference: All those sacred texts arise from the own āgama.
plain_english: O supreme Goddess, O lotus-faced one, all of that comes from one's own āgama.
